# B&D Realty

> Boutique luxury real estate agency in the Riviera Maya, Mexico (Tulum, Playa del Carmen and Cancún), founded by Benjamin Brasher and Jennifer Duzant, who bought here before becoming agents. We help international buyers purchase, sell and rent property, with honest valuations and a vetted shortlist of homes and developments.

Contact: Benjamin Brasher, WhatsApp +52 998 865 4691 · Jennifer Duzant, WhatsApp +52 998 291 8258 · benjamin@bdrealty.mx

## Buy
- [All property for sale](https://www.bdrealty.mx/properties.html): every villa, beachfront home and development in one list, filterable by location, type and price; each property has its own page with photos, price, details and our assessment
- [Deal of the Month](https://www.bdrealty.mx/#deal-of-the-month): one hand-picked price-reduced property, updated monthly
- [Luxury villas for sale](https://www.bdrealty.mx/top10-villas.html): villas in Tulum, Playa del Carmen and Cancún with prices
- [Beachfront property](https://www.bdrealty.mx/top10-beachfront.html): oceanfront homes and beach-access residences
- [New developments](https://www.bdrealty.mx/top10-developments.html): 15 pre-construction and delivered projects we recommend
- [Investors Circle](https://www.bdrealty.mx/investors.html): off-market and below-market opportunities

## Rent
- [Long-term rentals](https://www.bdrealty.mx/rentals-long-term.html): 12-month leases in Playa del Carmen and Tulum
- [Vacation rentals](https://www.bdrealty.mx/rentals-vacation.html): La Reserva Tulum residences and private villas (Villa Aqua, Villa Coco, Villa Kahaal)

## About
- [About B&D Realty](https://www.bdrealty.mx/about.html): founders Benjamin Brasher and Jennifer Duzant; over $30M in property sold; 12 years in Tulum; luxury pre-construction developments managed

## Sell and learn
- [Sell with us](https://www.bdrealty.mx/sell.html): pricing, marketing and international exposure for owners
- [How buying works](https://www.bdrealty.mx/the-process.html): our 5-step process and common questions from foreign buyers
- [Free Buyer's Guide to Mexico](https://www.bdrealty.mx/buyers-guide.html): 24-page PDF on fideicomiso, closing costs, due diligence and areas
